name: BlobResourceContents
description: The contents of a resource delivered as base64-encoded binary data: the blob, its URI, and an optional MIME type.

name: BooleanSchema
description: A primitive input schema for elicitation: a boolean field, with optional title, description and default.

name: ClientRequest
description: The requests a client sends to a server - MCP's session role, not JSON-RPC's per-exchange one: discovery, the resource, prompt and tool verbs, subscriptions and completion.

name: ContentBlock
description: The content a message may carry: text, image, audio, a resource link, or an embedded resource.

name: EnumSchema
description: The enum input schemas for elicitation: single- or multi-select, titled or untitled, and the legacy titled form.

name: Error
description: The JSON-RPC error object: an integer code, a short message, and optional sender-defined data.

name: InputRequest
description: A request the server raises mid-request for the client to answer - a sampling message, the roots list, or an elicitation - carried in an input-required result.

name: InputResponse
description: The client's answer to an input request: a sampling result, a roots list, or an elicitation result.

name: InputResponseRequestParams
description: Request parameters that carry the client's answers to earlier input requests and the server's request state, so a request can resume.

name: JSONArray
description: A JSON array: an ordered list of JSON values.

name: JSONObject
description: A JSON object: string keys to JSON values.

name: JSONValue
description: Any JSON value: an object, an array, a string, an integer, a boolean, or null.

name: MultiSelectEnumSchema
description: An enum input schema allowing several selected values, titled or untitled.

name: Notification
description: The payload of a JSON-RPC notification: a method name and optional params, and no id - nothing to correlate a reply with.

name: NumberSchema
description: A primitive input schema for elicitation: a number or integer field, with optional bounds and default.

name: PaginatedRequest
description: A request over a list, whose params carry the cursor of the page wanted.

name: PaginatedResult
description: A result over a list, whose nextCursor, when present, names the page after this one.

name: Request
description: The payload of a JSON-RPC request: a method name and optional params; the header and id are the envelope's.

name: SamplingMessageContentBlock
description: The content a sampling message may carry: text, image, audio, a tool use, or a tool result. Upstream marks it deprecated: it remains in the specification for at least twelve months, per the deprecated features registry.

name: ServerNotification
description: The notifications a server sends to a client - MCP's session role: cancellation and progress, list changes, resource updates, subscription acknowledgements, and log messages.

name: ServerResult
description: The results a server returns to a client. The bare Result branch admits any result shape, so as a validator this union refuses nothing the Result does not.

name: SingleSelectEnumSchema
description: An enum input schema allowing one selected value, titled or untitled.

name: StringSchema
description: A primitive input schema for elicitation: a string field, with optional length bounds, format and default.

name: TextResourceContents
description: The contents of a resource delivered as text, with its URI and an optional MIME type.
